claude.rationale: Both parties' operating businesses (NBCUniversal's networks, studios, theme parks; Comcast's content networks and internet businesses) were contributed whole into the new JV holding company as going concerns with their producing operations intact, so product (T4) and its production/delivery processes (T5) crossed together — no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). However, the closing-year risk factors explicitly single out "combining corporate cultures, maintaining employee morale and retaining key employees" and reliance on "on-air and creative talent" as the open integration question, indicating operations were combined while the organization/people/culture layer (T6) was structurally unresolved at closing (gap_56=1); T1 is imprint-share given the 51/49 control split with GE retaining a scheduled redemption interest rather than exiting. The slice documents no transitional-services or operating agreement absorbing the personnel/culture gap, so gap_mitigated=no.

gemini.rationale: The transaction structurally combined GE's NBC Universal businesses and Comcast's Content Business into a single new joint venture entity, NBCUniversal Holdings. There is no documented structural mismatch at closing between the transferred products and their underlying processes (gap_45=0), nor between the processes and the organization/people (gap_56=0), as the businesses were contributed intact, despite standard risk factors noting the challenges of integrating operations and cultures.

openai.rationale: GE contributed NBC Universal's operating businesses and Comcast contributed its content businesses and related assets, so customer-facing products and their associated operations crossed into NBCUniversal Holdings together; no product-versus-process structural mismatch is documented at closing. The closing-year 10-K expressly identified the still-open need to integrate operations and technologies while combining corporate cultures, maintaining morale, and retaining key employees, documenting a process-versus-organization alignment gap at closing. Although an operating agreement governed ownership and future redemption or purchase rights, the slice documents no transitional-services or operating arrangement that contractually absorbed this gap.
